mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 3% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5% MoM does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real estate activity (HOUST) over three months signals a weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods following a sustained decline in HOUST, or HOUST decline does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% MoM signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO drop > 2% MoM does not correlate with subsequent supply chain disruptions.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of FEDFUNDS > 4% and rising CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with an increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of decreasing PAYEMS and increasing UNRATE does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of periods following a sustained increase in RSAFS, or RSAFS increase does not correlate with subsequent strengthening of consumer demand.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 3% MoM signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase > 3% MoM does not correlate with subsequent robust economic activity.
